heading: none
name: 出血無外框卡片輪播＋右下箭頭
desc: 從畫面左緣延伸到右緣、一次露出約兩張半的無外框卡片輪播，下方靠右一組箭頭按鈕。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的區塊。區塊是橫向輪播，左緣貼齊畫面左緣、向右延伸到畫面右緣，一次露出兩個完整項目，第三個在右緣露出約一半並被裁切。每個項目無外框：上方是橫式圖片（同一比例），圖片上可疊小標題與大數字、可換成影片並在右上角放播放圖示，沒有時省略；圖片下方是說明文字（可多行），再下方靠右可放一個小圖示按鈕與一個文字連結，沒有時省略。輪播下方靠右放一組上一張與下一張箭頭按鈕，右緣對齊頁面內容寬度；不自動播放，到第一個或最後一個項目時停住、不循環。
mobile: 改為橫向滑動，邊緣露出下一個項目的一部分：輪播左緣改為對齊頁面內容寬度，一次露出一個完整項目，可左右滑動；箭頭按鈕留在輪播下方靠右。項目內部排列不變。

en.name: Bleeding frameless card carousel with arrows at bottom right
en.desc: A frameless card carousel running from the left viewport edge to the right edge, showing about two and a half items, with a pair of arrow buttons below on the right.
en.prompt: Create a section whose height is determined by its content. The section is a horizontal carousel whose left edge is flush with the left edge of the viewport and which extends to the right edge of the viewport, showing two full items at once with about half of a third visible and cut off at the right edge. Each item has no frame: a landscape image on top (all the same proportion); optionally overlay a small title and a large number on the image, or replace the image with a video with a play icon in the top-right corner; omit them when there is no content. Below the image is a description (may wrap to multiple lines), and optionally a small icon button and a text link below it, aligned right; omit them when there is no content. Below the carousel, aligned right, place a pair of previous and next arrow buttons whose right edge aligns with the page content width. The carousel does not autoplay, and it stops at the first and last items without looping.
en.mobile: Changes to horizontal swiping with part of the next item visible at the edge: the carousel's left edge aligns with the page content width instead, showing one full item at a time, swipeable left and right; the arrow buttons stay below the carousel, aligned right. The internal arrangement of each item is unchanged.

extras.name: 捲到時卡片由右滑入淡入
extras.prompt: 捲動到這個區塊時播放一次進場動畫，不固定、不跟著捲動進度播放：輪播的項目由右往左滑入並淡入。動畫在捲動停下後仍會播完。
extras.mobile: 手機保留同樣的進場效果。

en.name: Cards slide in and fade in on scroll
en.prompt: When the section is scrolled into view, play an entrance animation once, without pinning and without following scroll progress: the carousel items slide in from right to left while fading in. The animation finishes playing even after scrolling stops.
en.mobile: Mobile keeps the same entrance effect.
